title: A country with no rivers at all

sentences.text: Most countries have rivers.
Big ones, small ones, dry ones in summer.
Saudi Arabia has none.
sentences.translationRu: В Саудовской Аравии их нет вообще.

sentences.text: Not one river, in the whole country.
sentences.translationRu: Ни одной реки на всю страну.

sentences.text: And the country is very large.
Bigger than all of western Europe.
There are valleys where water once ran.
sentences.translationRu: Есть долины, где вода когда-то текла.

sentences.text: They are dry for most of the year.
After heavy rain they fill for a day.
sentences.translationRu: После сильного дождя они наполняются на день.

sentences.text: Then the water is gone again.
So where does the water come from?
Some of it comes from very deep wells.
That water is old.
Thousands of years old.
It fell as rain when the land was green.
sentences.translationRu: Она выпала дождём, когда эта земля была зелёной.

sentences.text: It has been underground since then.
sentences.translationRu: И с тех пор лежит под землёй.

sentences.text: When it is used, it does not come back.
sentences.translationRu: Когда её расходуют, она не возвращается.

sentences.text: Most of the water comes from the sea.
sentences.translationRu: Но большая часть воды идёт из моря.

sentences.text: Sea water has salt in it.
You cannot drink it.
So they take the salt out.
Big factories on the coast do this.
sentences.translationRu: Этим занимаются большие заводы на побережье.

sentences.text: They heat the water until it becomes steam.
sentences.translationRu: Воду греют, пока она не станет паром.

sentences.text: The salt stays behind.
The steam becomes clean water again.
This uses a lot of energy.
The country has oil, so it has energy.
sentences.translationRu: У страны есть нефть, значит есть энергия.

sentences.text: It is one of the largest such systems on Earth.
sentences.translationRu: Это одна из крупнейших таких систем на Земле.

sentences.text: Then the water travels inland.
Through pipes, for hundreds of kilometres.
Up hills, to cities in the desert.
sentences.translationRu: В гору, в города посреди пустыни.

sentences.text: A city of seven million people
drinks water that was in the sea last week.
sentences.translationRu: пьёт воду, которая неделю назад была в море.

sentences.text: There are a few other countries like this.
Some in the Middle East. A few small islands.
sentences.translationRu: Часть на Ближнем Востоке. Несколько малых островов.

sentences.text: For them, water is not found.
It is made.

title: An island that did not exist fifty years ago

sentences.text: Most islands are very old.
Millions of years old.
But some are new.
In 1963 a fisherman near Iceland
sentences.translationRu: В 1963 году рыбак у берегов Исландии

sentences.text: saw smoke coming out of the sea.
He thought a boat was on fire.
It was not a boat.
It was a volcano under the water.
Hot rock was coming up from below.
It met the cold sea and became solid.
sentences.translationRu: Она встречала холодное море и застывала.

sentences.text: Layer on layer, for days.
After a week there was land.
After a year it was a real island.
sentences.translationRu: Через год это был настоящий остров.

sentences.text: The eruption lasted almost four years.
Then it stopped.
Scientists asked an interesting question.
How does life arrive on new land?
sentences.translationRu: Как жизнь попадает на новую сушу?

sentences.text: So they made a rule.
Almost nobody can go there.
No plants brought by people.
No food, no seeds, nothing.
Then they watched, and they wrote it down.
Bacteria came first.
Then seeds, floating in the sea.
Then birds, resting on the rock.
Birds bring seeds inside them.
And they leave them behind.
Now there are hundreds of kinds of plants.
And insects, and birds that stay.
sentences.translationRu: И насекомые, и птицы, которые остаются.

sentences.text: One year a tomato plant appeared.
Scientists were confused for a while.
Then somebody admitted the truth.
A visitor had used the toilet outside.
sentences.translationRu: Гость сходил в туалет на улице.

sentences.text: The plant was removed.
The island is slowly getting smaller now.
The sea takes a little every year.
In a few hundred years it may be gone.
sentences.translationRu: Через несколько сотен лет его может не стать.

title: The whole town lives in one building

sentences.text: Whittier is a small town in Alaska.
About two hundred people live there.
Almost all of them live in the same building.
sentences.translationRu: И почти все — в одном здании.

sentences.text: Not the same street. The same building.
sentences.translationRu: Не на одной улице. В одном здании.

sentences.text: It is fourteen floors high.
It was built by the army in the 1950s.
When the army left, the town stayed.
Inside there is a shop.
A post office. A health centre.
A police station and a church.
The school is in a separate building.
Children reach it through a tunnel.
sentences.translationRu: Дети добираются до неё по тоннелю.

sentences.text: Which matters more than it sounds.
The weather is the reason for all of it.
Winter brings enormous amounts of snow.
Winds can pass a hundred kilometres an hour.
sentences.translationRu: Ветер бывает за сто километров в час.

sentences.text: Going outside is a decision, not a habit.
sentences.translationRu: Выйти на улицу — это решение, а не привычка.

sentences.text: Under one roof, nobody has to.
sentences.translationRu: Под одной крышей этого можно не делать.

sentences.text: Getting to the town is stranger still.
There is one road in.
It goes through a tunnel in a mountain.
sentences.translationRu: Она идёт через тоннель в горе.

sentences.text: The tunnel is one lane wide.
And it is shared with the railway.
Cars drive on the train tracks.
Traffic runs one way for half an hour.
sentences.translationRu: Полчаса движение идёт в одну сторону.

sentences.text: Then the other way.
Then a train comes through.
And at night the tunnel closes.
If you miss the last opening, you stay.
People who live there describe it oddly.
They say everybody knows everything.
sentences.translationRu: Говорят, все всё про всех знают.

sentences.text: Which is a small town anywhere.
But here you also hear it through the wall.
sentences.translationRu: Но тут это ещё и слышно через стену.

sentences.text: Some love it. Some leave.
What almost nobody says is that it is normal.
sentences.translationRu: Чего почти никто не говорит — что это нормально.

title: The small hole in an aircraft window

sentences.text: Look closely at a window on an aircraft.
Near the bottom there is a small hole.
About the width of a pin.
It looks like a fault.
It is the most deliberate part of the window.
sentences.translationRu: А это самая продуманная часть иллюминатора.

sentences.text: The window is not one sheet.
It is three, with small gaps between them.
The outer one is doing the real work.
At altitude the cabin is pressurised.
sentences.translationRu: На высоте в салоне поддерживают давление.

sentences.text: Inside is close to sea level.
Outside is very thin air.
The difference pushes outwards, hard.
Several tonnes across a single window.
The hole is in the middle pane.
And it does two jobs at once.
sentences.translationRu: И оно делает сразу две работы.

sentences.text: The first is about who carries the load.
sentences.translationRu: Первая — про то, кто несёт нагрузку.

sentences.text: The hole lets air pass into the gap.
So the pressure behind the middle pane
matches the pressure in the cabin.
Which means the middle pane carries almost nothing.
sentences.translationRu: А значит, среднее стекло почти ничего не несёт.

sentences.text: The outer pane takes the whole load.
That sounds like a bad idea.
It is the opposite.
If the outer pane ever failed,
the middle one is undamaged and fresh.
It has been resting the whole flight.
It can hold the pressure on its own.
A spare, kept deliberately unused.
The second job is simpler.
Warm wet cabin air meets a very cold pane.
sentences.translationRu: Тёплый влажный воздух салона встречает очень холодное стекло.

sentences.text: Water would condense in the gap.
And freeze, and you would see nothing.
sentences.translationRu: И замерзала бы — и ты ничего бы не видел.

sentences.text: The hole lets that moisture escape.
Which is why the view stays clear.
It is a good example of a certain kind of design.
sentences.translationRu: Это хороший пример определённого рода конструкции.

sentences.text: The part that looks like a mistake
is usually the part somebody thought hardest about.
sentences.translationRu: обычно та, над которой думали дольше всего.

title: The island that was on every map for a century

sentences.text: For over a hundred years
an island appeared on maps of the Pacific.
sentences.translationRu: на картах Тихого океана значился остров.

sentences.text: It had a name and a shape.
sentences.translationRu: У него были имя и очертания.

sentences.text: It was in atlases and in ship charts.
sentences.translationRu: Он был в атласах и в морских картах.

sentences.text: It was in digital maps as recently as 2012.
sentences.translationRu: Он был в цифровых картах ещё в 2012 году.

sentences.text: In that year a research ship sailed to it.
sentences.translationRu: В том году к нему подошло исследовательское судно.

sentences.text: Not to survey it. Just passing.
sentences.translationRu: Не чтобы его изучить. Просто мимо.

sentences.text: The map said land. The instruments said water.
Fourteen hundred metres of it, straight down.
There had never been an island there.
sentences.translationRu: Никакого острова там никогда не было.

sentences.text: Working out how it got onto the maps
sentences.translationRu: Выяснение того, как он попал на карты,

sentences.text: says a great deal about how maps are made.
sentences.translationRu: многое говорит о том, как карты делаются.

sentences.text: Nobody surveys the whole ocean.
It is far too large and far too deep.
sentences.translationRu: Он слишком велик и слишком глубок.

sentences.text: Charts are assembled from reports.
A ship passes, someone records what they saw,
sentences.translationRu: Судно прошло, кто-то записал, что видел,

sentences.text: and the record goes into a collection.
Later charts are compiled from earlier ones.
Which means an error, once entered,
sentences.translationRu: А значит, ошибка, однажды попавшая внутрь,

sentences.text: gets copied forward rather than tested.
Removing something is harder than adding it.
To add an island you need one sighting.
sentences.translationRu: Чтобы добавить остров, нужно одно наблюдение.

sentences.text: To remove one you need to prove a negative.
Somebody has to go to an empty patch of ocean
sentences.translationRu: Кто-то должен прийти в пустой участок океана

sentences.text: and demonstrate that nothing is there.
sentences.translationRu: и показать, что там ничего нет.

sentences.text: Nobody funds that expedition.
There is a second reason it survived.
sentences.translationRu: Есть и вторая причина, почему он уцелел.

sentences.text: Mapmakers have long inserted deliberate errors.
A street that does not exist. A bend that is wrong.
They are called trap streets.
If a rival's map contains your invented street,
sentences.translationRu: Если на карте конкурента есть твоя выдуманная улица,

sentences.text: they copied rather than surveyed.
sentences.translationRu: значит он копировал, а не измерял.

sentences.text: Which is provable in court.
So an anomaly on a chart
was not automatically treated as an error.
It might be somebody's signature.
The island was quietly deleted after 2012.
What is worth keeping is the general shape.
sentences.translationRu: Стоит запомнить общую форму этой истории.

sentences.text: A map is not a picture of the world.
It is a record of what people reported,
sentences.translationRu: Это запись того, что люди сообщили,

sentences.text: copied by people who were not there.
sentences.translationRu: переписанная людьми, которых там не было.

title: Why tourism goes where it is told

sentences.text: Nothing about a destination is obvious.
sentences.translationRu: В туристическом направлении нет ничего очевидного.

sentences.text: There is no natural reason
why one coast fills and another stays empty.
sentences.translationRu: почему одно побережье заполняется, а другое пустует.

sentences.text: Both may have the same sea and the same sun.
sentences.translationRu: У обоих может быть то же море и то же солнце.

sentences.text: What differs is a chain of decisions
that almost no traveller ever sees.
sentences.translationRu: которую почти никто из путешественников не видит.

sentences.text: It usually starts with an airport.
A runway long enough for a certain aircraft
makes a place reachable in one hop.
One hop and two are different products.
sentences.translationRu: Один перелёт и два — разные продукты.

sentences.text: The second is not slightly worse.
It removes most of the market.
Then comes capacity, which decides scale.
A region with two thousand hotel beds
sentences.translationRu: Регион на две тысячи гостиничных мест

sentences.text: cannot appear in a package brochure.
sentences.translationRu: не может попасть в каталог туроператора.

sentences.text: An operator needs volume to negotiate a price.
sentences.translationRu: Оператору нужен объём, чтобы торговаться о цене.

sentences.text: So it looks for places with ten thousand.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому он ищет места на десять тысяч.

sentences.text: Which means the beds must exist first.
sentences.translationRu: А значит, места должны появиться первыми.

sentences.text: Built on a promise, before the demand.
Usually with public money underwriting it.
That is the moment a coastline is decided.
sentences.translationRu: Вот в этот момент и решается судьба побережья.

sentences.text: Not by travellers, and not by the place.
sentences.translationRu: Не путешественниками и не самим местом.

sentences.text: By a spreadsheet, years earlier.
Once it is built, a second logic takes over.
sentences.translationRu: Когда всё построено, включается вторая логика.

sentences.text: The destination has to be filled every week.
An empty hotel costs almost what a full one does.
sentences.translationRu: Пустой отель стоит почти столько же, сколько полный.

sentences.text: So prices drop until the beds are used.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому цены падают, пока места не займут.

sentences.text: Which attracts a different visitor
than the one the brochure described.
The place then acquires a reputation
that it did not choose and cannot easily lose.
sentences.translationRu: которую не выбирало и от которой непросто избавиться.

sentences.text: Several Mediterranean coasts spent thirty years
sentences.translationRu: Несколько средиземноморских побережий провели тридцать лет,

sentences.text: trying to climb back out of that.
The method is always the same.
Restrict new building. Raise standards.
Accept fewer visitors paying more.
sentences.translationRu: Согласиться на меньше гостей, платящих больше.

sentences.text: It works, slowly, and it is politically brutal.
sentences.translationRu: Это работает, медленно, и политически жестоко.

sentences.text: Because the people who lose their jobs first
are the ones the old model employed.
sentences.translationRu: именно те, кого нанимала старая модель.

sentences.text: And the ones who gain are not there yet.
sentences.translationRu: А те, кто выиграет, ещё не приехали.

sentences.text: Which is the hardest trade in any policy.
sentences.translationRu: А это самый трудный размен в любой политике.

sentences.text: Paying now, in named people,
for a benefit that arrives to strangers.
